At Dolce Aesthetic Clinic, we believe aesthetics should never be about becoming someone else. It should be about bringing out the best version of you.
Our approach combines medical expertise, thoughtful treatment planning, advanced technology, and an understanding of natural beauty to create results that feel refined, balanced, and personal.

We believe in treating the person, not just the concern. Every face, body, skin type, and goal is different, which is why every Dolce journey begins with listening, understanding, and choosing what is genuinely right for the individual.
We value quality over quantity. More treatment does not always mean better results. We believe in recommending what you need—and being equally comfortable telling you what you don’t.
Our goal is not to chase every trend. It is to create results that are beautiful today and still feel beautiful tomorrow.
You should still look like you—refreshed, balanced, and elevated.
There is no universal treatment plan. Every Dolce experience is tailored to the individual.
We recommend treatments because they are appropriate, not simply because they can be sold.
We continuously invest in professional knowledge, advanced techniques, technology, and responsible treatment practices.
We think beyond a single appointment, focusing on skin health, prevention, maintenance, and results that evolve beautifully over time.
From the moment you enter, you should feel listened to, cared for, comfortable, and confident in the hands of our team.

We don’t want to change the way you look.
We want to change the way you feel about the way you look.

It began with a simple but powerful belief: when people feel cared for, confident, and inspired, they can become the best version of themselves.

In January 2022, founders Maya Al-Wattar and Shatu Shali brought that belief to life through Dolce Aesthetic Clinic — a modern destination for aesthetics, skin, laser, and wellness, created to combine trusted expertise with an elevated, deeply personal client experience.

From the beginning, Dolce was about more than treatments. It was about creating a place where every visit could become a moment of transformation — a moment to pause, reconnect, and leave feeling renewed.
As our community grew, so did our vision.

We launched Polished Salon to extend that feeling of confidence and self-care into beauty — with hair, nails, lashes, brows, and more, all delivered through the same commitment to quality and experience.
Then came Core Yoga & Pilates Studio, adding movement, strength, balance, and mindful wellness to the journey through Reformer Pilates, yoga, and purposeful practice.
Together, these three brands have become more than individual businesses. They have grown into one connected ecosystem built around the complete wellbeing experience:
And now, that experience is entering its next chapter.

It is more than a digital platform. It is the connection that brings every part of the Dolce experience closer to our clients — and creates new opportunities for our community to engage, return, and grow with us.
But this is only the beginning.
What began as one clinic in Erbil has evolved into a distinctive multi-brand concept with a clear purpose, a proven foundation, and the ambition to reach new communities.
We are now opening franchising and expansion opportunities for select partners who share our belief in elevated service, meaningful experiences, and the future of integrated beauty and wellness.

This is an opportunity to bring more than a business to a new market. It is an opportunity to bring a complete lifestyle destination — a place where people can invest in their appearance, wellbeing, confidence, and everyday quality of life.

Get our expert skin specialists' opinion on what dermatology services will best suit you. From lasers, chemical peels and injectable skin boosters, to the top medical devices to tighten, rejuvenate and revive your skin.
What we treat, one by one

At Dolce, our dermatology and non-invasive treatments are chosen to address a wide range of skin concerns with precision and care. Morpheus8 refines the appearance of acne scarring while lifting and tightening the skin, and Carboxy therapy uses medical-grade CO₂ to thicken the skin and encourage the formation of new collagen.

For texture and fine lines, our Fractional Laser softens the appearance of wrinkles and treats acne scars by stimulating collagen production. Mesotherapy is a technique that uses injections of vitamins, enzymes, hormones, and plant extracts to rejuvenate and tighten skin.
Each treatment is recommended following a consultation with our specialists, so that every plan reflects your skin, your concerns and your goals.

At Dolce Aesthetic Clinic we pride ourselves on using top clinical-grade products in our facial treatments, with a wide selection to help deeply cleanse and rejuvenate your skin. You'll leave with our Dolce glow!

Dermal fillers are versatile cosmetic injectables that can enhance your natural beauty and restore a youthful appearance. Experience an instant confidence boost by creating lift, restoring volume, smoothing deep creases, and contouring facial features. With minimal downtime and long-lasting results, Dolce Aesthetic Clinic's bespoke filler treatments are popular for all demographics.

At Dolce we administer the FDA approved Allergan Botox as muscle relaxing injections, which have an immediate effect on freezing the muscles, the main cause for creating lines and wrinkles. By injecting Botox we can effectively prevent the skin from creasing and creating frown lines on the forehead and crow's feet around eyes and also minor facial corrections.

PRP (Platelet-Rich Plasma) therapy is one of our most effective non-surgical treatments for hair thinning and early-stage hair loss. A small sample of the patient's own blood is drawn and processed to concentrate its platelets, which are then injected into the scalp. The growth factors released stimulate dormant follicles, extend the hair's natural growth phase and improve density over a course of sessions. Because the treatment uses the patient's own blood, it carries minimal risk and requires no downtime — making it a popular, medically-grounded option for both men and women noticing early signs of thinning.

Put an end to slow, messy and painful hair removal methods such as shaving, waxing, tweezing and creams. Our Xlase Machine uses short, safe bursts of light from a cold tip to remove unwanted hair from all body sites.
Pain tolerance is very individual. No anaesthetic is required — most people describe the sensation as similar to a cold ice cube moving across the skin.
Shave 24–48 hours before treatment, and avoid plucking, waxing or hair-removal cream for four weeks after. Avoid sun and self-tanning before and during treatment.
Clinical studies confirm at least 3–6 treatments are needed, spaced 1–3 months apart. Call +964-750-900-0200 to discuss your plan.

An innovative branch of medicine allowing women to improve appearance or function for personal or medical reasons. Our Forma V device by Votiva InMode is the latest technology resolving vaginal and urethral issues related to menopause and natural ageing, restoring internal and external vaginal health through natural healing and tightening.

If sagging, loose facial skin or stubborn wrinkles — or a nose that isn't quite the shape you'd like — are on your mind, our facial and body procedures are designed to rejuvenate your appearance and restore your confidence, prioritising the safest, highest-quality results.
Upper & Lower BlepharoplastyEyelid surgery to remove excess skin, tighten and create an eyelid crease.
Face Lift (Rhytidectomy)Addresses sagging and wrinkles in the mid-to-lower face by tightening underlying tissue and removing excess skin.
Neck LiftOften performed with a face lift for a harmonious result.
Brow LiftElevates a drooping eyebrow.
RhinoplastyAdjusts the size, shape and projection of the nose.
Lip LiftRemoves a section of tissue along the base of the nose for a fuller, more youthful pout.

Aesthetic body surgeries significantly alter and improve the appearance of the body — for areas affected by weight change, pregnancy or excess skin. Every procedure is individualised with our specialist surgeon during your consultation.
LiposuctionRemoves fat from areas such as the abdomen, arms, thighs and chin.
Breast AugmentationImproves breast size or shape.
Fat GraftingRemoves fat from one area and uses it to enhance another.
Tummy TuckFlattens, smooths and tightens the abdomen.
Abdominal liposuction Day of surgery · 10 days after
Can I undergo more than one facial procedure?

If desired, we can combine two or more procedures into one surgery to achieve more comprehensive facial rejuvenation and a balanced look. Combining procedures also has the benefit of less overall downtime and lower costs compared to undergoing multiple separate surgeries.
To learn more, book your consultation with our plastic surgeon today.
